reason: The hypothesis directly restates the well-known mechanism from P2, P9, P14, P22, and P29 that fine grains accelerate oxidation via grain boundary diffusion, leading to thick, cracked oxide scales and spallation, and proposes the obvious remedy of grain coarsening by annealing. It applies this generic idea to a new alloy composition (Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3) without any new mechanistic insight or integration of conflicting evidence, making it a trivial extension of existing results.
